d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how, after a dramatic political shift in Washington that gave Democrats control of the US Congress, South African leadership sees a promising opportunity for a diplomatic reset after a tense period under the Trump administration. The recent decision by the US to terminate South Africa's duty-free access under the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) starting January 1 has threatened local jobs and drawn sharp rebukes from officials like Foreign Minister Ronald Lamola.
